audit_finding.formula: concentrated_check_distribution matched the two-point MEAN check degree (w_lo = dc_hi - dc_mean), which does not satisfy the edge-perspective rate condition sum_j rho_j/j = (1-R) * sum_i lambda_i/i exactly (relative error ~1e-4); the concentrated rho used by the reproduction was therefore biased. Non-tuning formula correction.
audit_finding.citation: REPRODUCTION_CITATION listed the first author with the wrong given name ('Rasmus T. Mueller' instead of 'Ronny Mueller') and 'Leif K. Oxenløwe' instead of the full 'Leif Katsuo Oxenløwe'; corrected to the exact arXiv:2307.02225v2 author list.
audit_finding.tolerance_arithmetic: the frozen tolerance justification 0.005+0.003+0.0025 = 0.015 was arithmetically invalid; replaced by 0.0005 + 0.00125 + 0.005 + 0.005 = 0.01175 <= 0.012.

formula_old_to_new.old: dc_mean = 1 / ((1 - rate) * integral_lambda); d_lo = max(2, floor(dc_mean)); w_lo = dc_hi - dc_mean; w_hi = dc_mean - dc_lo; the two-point mean equals dc_mean (approximation; sum_j rho_j/j = 1/dc_mean + O(1e-4 relative))
formula_old_to_new.new: integral = sum_i lambda_i/i; target = (1 - rate) * integral; dc = 1/target; d_lo = floor(dc); d_hi = d_lo + 1; integer dc degenerates to {d_lo: 1.0}; else w_lo = (target - 1/d_hi) / (1/d_lo - 1/d_hi), w_hi = 1 - w_lo; sum_j rho_j/j = target exactly; rate_reconstructed = 1 - target/integral
formula_old_to_new.new_helper: reconstructed_rate(lambda_edge, rho_edge) = 1 - (sum_j rho_j/j) / (sum_i lambda_i/i); added to __all__; per-entry validation identical to edge_mean_inverse
